name: Residence Permit for a Family Member (spouse)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the spouse of a person legally residing in Estonia (an Estonian citizen or a holder of an Estonian residence permit) who is inviting you.
Requires sufficient income to support yourself in Estonia, set at twice the national subsistence level.
requirements.fix_path: Document income at or above twice the current subsistence level.

evidence_required.document: Proof of income at 2x the subsistence level

outcome.duration_length: up to 5 years initially (not exceeding the inviting spouse's own permit validity), extendable up to 10 years at a time

sources.title: Police and Border Guard Board of Estonia (politsei.ee) -- Residence permit for a family member: for a spouse

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Estonia's initial build. The source page ties this permit's validity to the inviting spouse's own permit validity where the inviting spouse is not an Estonian citizen -- captured in duration_length rather than as a separate schema field. Politsei.ee also documents separate family-member routes for minor children and for parents/grandparents, not built as separate route files in this pass; flagged as a scope decision (spouse is the highest-volume, clearest case) rather than an oversight. leads_to_pr is false for this route directly since the source page doesn't confirm an automatic path, but 5 years' residence under it is exactly the kind of legal residence that can feed ee_long_term_resident's own 5-year test -- modelled via switchable_to.
